capabilities: chat with one note or the whole vault with deterministic source lists
build a wiki layer of summary cards, cross-links, and concept pages above raw notes
generate quizzes and flashcards from any note
surface gaps, stale pages, and contradictions between notes
suggest tags, links, and formatting improvements behind previews
extras: Desktop-only (needs WebGPU and a one-time ~3 GB model download); GPL-3.0 with no paid tier; README warns to exclude the model file from vault sync services and points to further docs in docs/features.md.
motivation: The author accumulated unprocessed Web Clipper saves and wanted a tool to work through the backlog already in the vault, plus wanted to test whether a model can run inside Obsidian's own process rather than a separate app.
problem: Vaults full of clipped articles and saved notes go unread because there is no easy way to see, query, connect, or review what you have collected without opening notes one at a time.

relations.evidence: LLM Wiki for the three-layer (raw / wiki / schema) pattern this project is working toward
the runtime this plugin is built on

summary: Local-AI plugin that runs Gemma 4 E4B in-process via WebGPU to chat with your notes and build a Karpathy-style wiki layer with quizzes and flashcards.
